response.sql:
WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) as telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(telescope_count AS DECIMAL)) as avg_telescope_count
  FROM station_stats
)
SELECT 
  ss.observstation,
  ss.avg_bandwidth,
  ss.telescope_count,
  CAST(ss.telescope_count AS DECIMAL) / gac.avg_telescope_count as telescope_ratio
FROM station_stats ss
CROSS JOIN global_avg gac
ORDER BY telescope_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Stations with zero telescopes are included in the calculation of the global average telescope count per station. These stations appear in results with ratio = 0 ÷ global_average.
Missing values (NULL) in bandusagepct are ignored when computing the average, using SQL's standard AVG() behavior.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude observatory stations that operate no telescopes from both the results and the global average denominator, limiting the ranking to stations with active telescope fleets.
alternatives.sql:
WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) as telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
  HAVING COUNT(t.telescregistry) > 0
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(telescope_count AS DECIMAL)) as avg_telescope_count
  FROM station_stats
)
SELECT 
  ss.observstation,
  ss.avg_bandwidth,
  ss.telescope_count,
  CAST(ss.telescope_count AS DECIMAL) / gac.avg_telescope_count as telescope_ratio
FROM station_stats ss
CROSS JOIN global_avg gac
ORDER BY telescope_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
